verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents ring groups that let several people answer calls to one number, including a round-robin mode that rings members in random order until someone answers. However, the evidence does not show a simultaneous-ring option, a fixed-order sequential mode, or routing of unanswered ring-group calls to voicemail or another number. Missing for 10: documented simultaneous ring mode, sequential (fixed-order) ringing, unanswered-call overflow to voicemail or an external number, independent or hands-on corroboration.
